name: cultural_food_guide
description: Identifies food from a photo and explains its ingredients, allergens, and cultural context.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
